name: Under Cambion Rule
source:
After being imprisoned at an early age, locked in a cell in the Eastern kingdom's dungeon. You manage to escape along with an elf girl who was imprisoned with you. The two of you traveled south together for the last 5 years, but now the two of you decided that it was finally time to settle down and find a place to call home.
This is where the your story beings...​

[From [url=https://f95zone.to/threads/under-cambion-rule-v0-1-reigning-plague-creations.312513/]F95 Zone[/url]]
translation:
年幼时便遭到囚禁、被关押在东方王国地牢牢房里的你，最终与一同被囚的精灵少女成功越狱逃亡。过去5年间，你们两人一路结伴南下漂泊；如今，你们终于决定安定下来，寻觅一处可以称之为“家”的地方。
属于你的故事，便从这里拉开帷幕……
